title: University of Minnesota researchers hope FREUD tool will detect early signs of serious mental illness
description: The project, known as Fast, Reliable, Electronic, Unconscious, Detection, or FREUD, would use measurement of brain activity to detect early, subconscious signals of hesitation or pause over specific images that may signal the early stages of certain conditions.
